top_signal.title: Anyone else financially able to slow down, but unable to switch off from their business?
top_signal.summary: I’m 38 and have been running businesses for over 15 years. I’m in a fortunate position where I could afford to work less, but I struggle to actually do it.  I genuinely enjoy finding and launching products, improving things and seeing the business grow. Whenever I have a day off or some spare time, my mind goes straight back to what I could launch or push next.   The problem is that it creates more work, and I’m already overwhelmed with the daily orders and running everything. I keep saying I’ll simplify things and get ahead, but I never seem to get there.   I have ADHD and have recently been diagnosed Major recurring depression which has then changed to potential Bipolar 2 , so I’ve been struggling with my mental health, so I know my health needs to come first. But understanding that hasn’t made it easy to change.  I originally thought I wanted a smaller product range. Now I’m realising I might still enjoy the variety if someone dependable handled fulfilment. Even then, though, I’d love to have something outside business that I felt equally interested in.  I also have struggled to employ in the past , which I think may be due to my mood cycles from depression/bipolar so I’m feeling uncertain about trying employing again   Has anyone been in a similar position—where you don’t need to keep pushing financially, but business is so rewarding that you struggle to stop?
